truc_A_1_diem.cong_thuc: Von dau tu = VCSH (gom CD khong kiem soat) + no vay - tien - dau tu nam giu den ngay dao han, binh quan dau/cuoi ky; 7.137 (2021) -> 14.231 (2025) -> 13.535 (30/6/2026). ROIC phieu = (LNTT + lai vay) x (1 - thue hieu dung) / von binh quan. ROIC van hanh = (lai gop - CPBH - CPQL + lai cong ty lien ket) x 80% / von binh quan — bo lai tien gui (212 ty 2025) va lai thanh ly tau. 12T den 6/2026 dung von binh quan 31/12/2025 va 30/6/2026 (khong co BCDKT 30/6/2025).
truc_A_1_diem.vi_sao_1_khong_phai_2: Ba ky gan nhat ROIC van hanh 13,5% / 10,8% / 13,5% so moc 12,5%: +1,0 / -1,7 / +1,0 diem -> o 'ROIC xap xi chi phi von'. Hai dieu kien con lai cua o 2 diem DAT (dong tien theo sat loi nhuan; bien dung vung qua nhip chu ky — 2021 bien gop van tai thap nhat 17,3% ma ROIC van hanh van 12,2%); dieu kien con thieu la nang nhat: vuot WACC on dinh. Hai bang chung keo ve 1: (1) ROIC gia tang cua lan song mua tau ngang WACC — tu 2022 den 12T 6/2026 NOPAT loi +858 ty tren 6.713 ty von tang them = 12,8% (den 2025 chi 7,1% vi tau moi giao cuoi nam); (2) ky manh nhat co yeu to chu ky — 6T2026 bien gop quoc te 19,6% (cung ky 14,5%), noi dia 38,3% (cung ky 31,2%); cong ty noi do tau moi + hieu qua khai thac, nhung BCTN 2025 nhac xung dot Trung Dong/Iran day cuoc; chua tach duoc.
truc_A_1_diem.cho_phai_cong_bang: Nang diem: trong so no gop -> WACC ~10,8% -> ROIC van hanh vuot o 5/6 ky (rieng 2025 ngang) -> A = 2; khau hao than trong (rut doi tau; tai san khau hao het van dung 1.535 ty, 1.694 ty tai 6/2026) lam ROIC so sach thap hon kinh te; hop dong cho thue da ky 1.381 -> 5.240 ty trong 2025 (2.571 ty thu sau 5 nam). Ha diem: cong phai tra PVN va 541 ty du phong sua chua lon vao von -> ROIC -0,5 diem; beta 1,3 (WACC 13,5%) doc ba nam 2023-2025 (13,0%, 13,5%, 10,8%) co hai nam duoi/bang chi phi von = 'phan lon ba nam' -> A = 0. Diem truc A nhay voi WACC o muc +/-1 diem %.

truc_B_1_diem.loi_the_goi_ten_duoc: 100% thi phan van tai dau tho va LPG noi dia, ~30% xang dau noi dia (BCTN 2025); hang tu BSR, Nghi Son, PV GAS, PVOIL gan voi PVN nam 51%. Quy doi duoc mot phan: bien gop noi dia 28,3-38,3% so quoc te 14,5-20,2% tren ~1/3 DT van tai. Hop dong cho thue da ky 5.240 ty cuoi 2025, thoi han 5-15 nam.
truc_B_1_diem.do_nhay_gia_ban_4pct: 4% DT van tai + FSO = 418 ty = 22,9% EBIT loi 2025; 12T den 6/2026 475 ty = 20,3%. Ca hai tren nguong 20% -> truc B bi tran o 1. truc_B_1_diem.cau_truc_nganh: Thuan: Nghi Son can 5-6 tau VLGC cho 10 trieu tan/nam, PVT se dau tu neu co hop dong dai han (DHDCD 2026). Nghich, do duoc: theo BCTN 2025 90% doi tau khai thac quoc te, 18% so tau tren 20 tuoi (ap luc bao duong, CII/EEXI); BDI 2025 giam binh quan 28%. Nghich, chua do duoc: dat dong moi tau hoa chat tang nhung khong co so. Chieu thuan do duoc nen B khong xuong 0.
truc_B_1_diem.cho_phai_cong_bang: Loi the noi dia la loi the duoc giao tu co dong me, nen cung la rui ro: gia cuoc dam phan trong noi bo tap doan, bien noi dia dao dong 28-38% chu khong phang nhu hop dong gia co dinh. Ban cho don vi PVN 2025 ~3.682 ty = 23% DT. BSR dung may bao duong hoac PVN dieu chinh gia giao dich noi bo -> khoan chenh bien co lai ma PVT khong co don bay giu.

bang_chung_xau_xep_theo_suc_nang: Khong tim thay bang chung o hai bac nang nhat (co quan quan ly ket luan so lieu sai; khoan muc trong yeu khong thuyet minh).

2. bang_chung_tot: 1. Thuyet minh tu khop: chi phi theo yeu to 2025 9.074,6 + gia von hang thuong mai 5.134,3 = 14.208,9 = gia von 13.665,4 + CPBH 13,9 + CPQL 529,6.

4. Khong truot chi tieu: LNTT 2021-2025 7.568 ty = 176% ke hoach 5 nam; LNTT 2025 = 138% ke hoach; 6T2026 da dat 91% ke hoach LNST ca nam. Ke hoach dat thap nen chi la bang chung giu cam ket, chua phai nang luc.

truc_C_1_diem.vi_sao_1_khong_phai_0: Khong co khoan phan bo von pha gia tri ma khong giai trinh, khong cho vay ben lien quan, khong co ket luan cua co quan quan ly ve so lieu.

kiem_dinh_do_ben: Nhu tren: A1 B1 C1 = 3 -> CHO
Noi A = 2 (trong so no gop, WACC 10,8%): 2-1-1 = 4 -> DAT
Noi B = 2 (phep kiem nhan gia chi ap phan quoc te, 14,8%): 1-2-1 = 4 -> DAT
Noi hai truc A va B: 2-2-1 = 5 -> DAT
Noi toi da (them C = 2: coi ROIC gia tang 14,5% la tao gia tri do duoc): 2-2-2 = 6 -> DAT
Ha A (beta 1,3, WACC 13,5%, ba nam 2023-2025): 0-1-1 = 2 -> PHU QUYET
Ha C (Global Pacific la ben lien quan cua nguoi noi bo PVT, gia thue tren thi truong): 1-1-0 = 2 -> PHU QUYET

Muon dao sang DAT phai tin MOT trong hai dieu: (1) bien gop van tai ~23-24% cua 12T gan nhat la mat bang moi (doi tau tre hon + hop dong dai han), tuc ROIC van hanh giu >= 13,5% khi cuoc quoc te ha nhiet; (2) phan lon DT noi dia co gia cuoc khoa nhieu nam.

3. Lam ro Nhat Viet va PVcomBank: bao cao quan tri 2025 va 6T2026; quan he Global Pacific - ong Nguyen Hong Hiep; gia thue 2 tau dong moi; chu so huu tau Athena, Minerva, Pacific Hope; chinh sach gui tien tai ngan hang cung tap doan.
